adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#10
adds.text: Kasius, raging on odium, is about to kill Mack when Simmons stabs him with a deafening implant, letting Mack kill him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who saves Mack from Kasius.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who kills Kasius once she stops him.
adds.evidence: Past Life (5x10): Simmons injects Kasius with Ava's deafening implant before he kills Mackenzie, enabling Mack to slay him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
adds.text: Fitz goes back into Qovas' ship to save Mack from two Remorath. When Fitz is buried under rubble in Chicago, Mack digs him out and stays at his side, crying, as he dies.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's closest friend, who dies in Mack's arms in Chicago.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, who stays with him as he dies.
adds.evidence: The End (5x22): Fitz and May rescue Mackenzie from two Remorath; Mackenzie and May clear the rubble over Fitz and remain at his side until he dies.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
adds.text: May and Mack dig Fitz out of the rubble in Chicago together and stay with him, both crying, as he dies.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who stays with Mack at Fitz's side.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who stays with May at Fitz's side.
adds.evidence: The End (5x22): Mackenzie and May clear the rubble over Fitz and, both crying, remain at his side until he dies.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#17
adds.text: Piper finds Mack locked in a cell at the Lighthouse, and the two rush the wounded Deke into surgery and save his life.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps Mack save Deke's life.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Piper finds locked up, then saves Deke with.
adds.evidence: The Honeymoon (5x17): Piper finds Mackenzie locked in a cell; Piper and Mackenzie take Shaw to surgery and save him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
adds.text: May finds that Hale's driver, taken aboard the Zephyr, is Creel in a bomb belt, ready to blow up the plane unless Hale goes free.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hale's driver, who threatens to blow up the Zephyr.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who catches him wearing a bomb on the Zephyr.
adds.evidence: The Devil Complex (5x14): Coulson, May and Piper capture Hale and her driver; May discovers the driver is Carl Creel with a bomb belt ready to blow up the Zephyr.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16
adds.text: Davis flies Daisy to the Retreat in a Quinjet so she can find Robin and ask where Coulson is.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who flies Daisy to find Robin.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Davis flies to find Robin.
adds.evidence: Inside Voices (5x16): Johnson and James Davis fly a Quinjet to the Retreat, where Robin is hiding with Polly.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
adds.text: While Daisy tries to calm Ruby down, Yo-Yo cuts Ruby's throat for taking her arms, and Daisy blames her for the killing.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who kills Ruby as Daisy tries to calm her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who blames Yo-Yo for killing Ruby.
adds.evidence: All Roads Lead... (5x18): Hale and Quake are calming Ruby when Rodriguez slits Ruby's throat with her chakram; Quake blames Rodriguez for killing Ruby.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#4
adds.text: Kasius questions Daisy and Simmons together with a telepath, and they convince him they came to the Lighthouse alone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A best friend held with Daisy by Kasius.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A best friend held with Simmons by Kasius.
adds.evidence: A Life Earned (5x4): using Ben, Kasius interrogates Daisy and Simmons about the others; they convince him they came alone.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
adds.text: Fitz straps Daisy to a table and forces out her inhibitor so her powers can seal the rift, though she tells him she will never forgive him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who forces out Daisy's inhibitor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who swears she won't forgive Fitz.
adds.evidence: The Devil Complex (5x14): as the Doctor, Fitz straps Johnson to a table and forcefully extracts her inhibitor while she says she will never forgive him; she then uses her powers on the gravitonium.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#19
adds.text: Daisy and May secretly ask Caine to look into Project Deathlok for a cure for Coulson, and May promises to cover for Daisy at the Lighthouse.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A mentor who covers for Daisy's secret plan to save Coulson.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A protégée May covers for while seeking a cure for Coulson.
adds.evidence: Option Two (5x19): Johnson and May ask Caine to investigate Project Deathlok to help Coulson; Johnson leaves and May assures her she will cover for her in the Lighthouse.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
adds.text: Piper interrupts Daisy's goodbye with Deke to tell her Talbot is attacking Chicago.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who brings Daisy word of Talbot's attack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Piper warns about Talbot's attack.
adds.evidence: The End (5x22): Johnson's talk with Shaw is interrupted by Piper, who informs them that Talbot is attacking Chicago.
